title: [Feature Request] Different carb factors for different times
symptom: The user requests the ability to set different carb factors for different times of day, as insulin sensitivity varies.
fix: The feature is already implemented: you can split the time blocks to use different carb factors. To split a block, touch and hold on the time above the block for 3-5 seconds, then the block splits and you can change the time for your first block.
evidence_quote: Touch/hold  time above block and after 3-5 sec. block splits and u can change time for your First block
